entities.name: Ifenprodil
observations: In mouse forced swim tests, 10 mg/kg potentiated imipramine- and fluoxetine-induced reductions in immobility, but did not enhance reboxetine or tianeptine at tested doses.
At 0.5 mg/kg, potentiated subeffective lithium and paroxetine effects; 0.5 mg/kg was inactive alone in those interaction studies.

entities.name: Imipramine
observations: Ifenprodil 10 mg/kg potentiated the antidepressant-like effect of imipramine 15 mg/kg in the mouse forced swim test.

entities.name: Fluoxetine
observations: Ifenprodil 10 mg/kg potentiated the antidepressant-like effect of fluoxetine 5 mg/kg in the mouse forced swim test.

entities.name: Reboxetine
observations: No potentiation by ifenprodil 10 mg/kg was detected with reboxetine 2.5 mg/kg in the mouse forced swim test; the study did not establish inhibition.

entities.name: Tianeptine
observations: No potentiation by ifenprodil 10 mg/kg was detected with tianeptine 15 mg/kg in the mouse forced swim test; the study did not establish inhibition.

entities.name: Paroxetine
observations: Ifenprodil 0.5 mg/kg potentiated the effect of subeffective paroxetine 4 mg/kg in the mouse forced swim test; either subdose alone was inactive.

entities.name: Lithium
observations: Ifenprodil 0.5 mg/kg potentiated the effect of subeffective lithium 10 mg/kg in the mouse forced swim test; either subdose alone was ineffective.
